label: 道路连接连连看
description: 把单张 POI 网格里的连接点用连连看式折线路径（最多 maxTurns 次转弯，0转弯=直线、1转弯=L形、2转弯=Z/S形）在障碍约束下全部连通成一张道路拓扑；连连看找不到通道时降级 A* 兜底。输入/输出都是单张 grid（item），网格列表由引擎按 DataTree 自动逐张 fanout。coverPoi=false 时输出会扣掉 POI 格点。
description-en: Connects the points in a single POI grid into one road topology using link-game style paths (at most maxTurns turns: 0=straight, 1=L-shape, 2=Z/S-shape) under obstacle constraints, falling back to A* when no link route exists. Input/output are single grids (item); the engine fans out a DataTree of grids one-by-one. When coverPoi is false the POI cells are removed from the output.
icon: 俯视地图上若干圆点被两段折线连通，路径呈L形或Z形，线条干净笔直，深色底配亮白折线，扁平插画风格，简洁小图标，主色2种。

inputs.name: poiGrid
inputs.label: POI 网格
inputs.description: 单张 POI 网格，自动取值最大的格子坐标作为连接点（保留网格尺寸）。网格列表由引擎按 DataTree 自动逐张 fanout。
inputs.description-en: A single POI grid; cells with the maximum value are extracted as connection points (grid size preserved). The engine fans out a DataTree of grids one-by-one.

inputs.name: obstacle
inputs.label: 障碍场
inputs.description: 障碍物网格，非零格不可通行。不传时按 poiGrid 尺寸建空白障碍。
inputs.description-en: Obstacle grid; non-zero cells are impassable. If omitted, an empty obstacle of poiGrid size is used.

inputs.name: roadWidth
inputs.label: 道路宽度
inputs.description: 道路宽度（格），通过膨胀实现。默认 1。
inputs.description-en: Road width in cells via dilation. Default 1.

inputs.name: roadValue
inputs.label: 道路值
inputs.description: 道路格写入的数值，默认 1。
inputs.description-en: Value written to road cells. Default 1.

inputs.name: maxTurns
inputs.label: 最大转弯次数
inputs.description: 连连看寻路最大转弯次数。0=仅直线；1=允许 L 形；2=允许 Z/S 形。默认 2。
inputs.description-en: Max turns for link-game routing. 0 = straight only; 1 = allow L-shape; 2 = allow Z/S-shape. Default 2.

inputs.name: coverPoi
inputs.label: 覆盖格点
inputs.description: 是否在输出道路中保留 POI 格点。true：道路包含 POI 格点；false：从道路中扣掉 POI 格点（POI 所在位置置 0）。默认 false。
inputs.description-en: Whether to keep POI cells in the output road. true: road includes POI cells; false: POI cells are removed from the output (set to 0). Default false.

outputs.name: topology
outputs.label: 道路拓扑
outputs.description: 道路线网 0/roadValue grid，道路格=roadValue，其余=0。
outputs.description-en: Road topology grid (0/roadValue); road cells = roadValue, others = 0.

outputs.name: outputNameList
outputs.label: 名称清单
outputs.description: 名称清单，格式 [{id, name, type}]，包含道路项。
outputs.description-en: Name list [{id, name, type}] with the road entry.
